name: Sceva
overview: The account of Sceva in Acts 19 reveals a cautionary episode where seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief of priests in Ephesus, attempted to invoke the name of Jesus to cast out evil spirits without true authority or faith. Their effort ended in failure when the evil spirit recognized Jesus and Paul but rejected their claim, resulting in the sons being overpowered and publicly humiliated. This incident underscores the power and reality of Jesus' name while warning against presumptuous attempts to wield spiritual authority apart from genuine relationship with Christ.
